resources.string: Translation model not installed. Tap to open the app.
Text is too long (max %1$d characters). Select a part of it.
The text changed while translating. Tap Insert to add the translation.
The clipboard is empty. Copy a message first.
Could not undo: the text has changed.
Write in Turkish, then tap Translate.
Write in English, then tap Translate.
A keyboard that translates what you write, entirely on this phone. Nothing you type is sent anywhere.
Switch to %1$s? This downloads %2$s once. The current model keeps working until the download has finished, and is deleted after that.
%1$s is not installed yet (%2$s). It is downloaded once. After that, translation works without internet. WiFi recommended.
Downloading the translation model: %1$s / %2$s. You can leave this screen and the download continues.
Ready. The model loads when you use the keyboard.
Not enough free storage. %1$s is needed.
Not enabled. Tap Enable and turn on \"Tercüman\".
Enabled. Tap Switch keyboard to start using it.
Took %1$.1f s (the first translation also loads the model).
Keep the model in memory for %1$d min after use
Turkish Q layout with separate ğ ü ş ı ö ç keys (off: QWERTY, hold u for ü, s for ş and so on)
Delete the translation model from this phone? You can download it again later.

Translation model: TranslateGemma 4B by Google, provided under the Gemma Terms of Use (https://ai.google.dev/gemma/terms). Inference: llama.cpp (MIT licence). Tip: in any app you can also select text and choose \"Translate (Tercüman)\" from the menu.
